'''Cerandin''' is a [[Seanchan]] ''[[s'redit]]'' handler who [[Elayne]] and [[Nynaeve]] found traveling with [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show]].

== Appearance ==
She has pale hair.

== History ==
She served as a ''s'redit'' handler at the [[Court of the Nine Moons]].

== Activities ==
In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Falme]], Cerandin was left behind. She gathered three of the ''s'redit'' along with an ''[[a'dam]]'' and eventually joined [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show]]. While with the show, she trained and exhibited the ''s'redit'', which [[Valan Luca|Luca]] called "giant boar-horses".{{ref/book|5|13}} [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]] recognized her as [[Seanchan]] and questioned her.{{ref/book|5|17}} She concluded that they are the [[Westlands|westland]] equivalent of [[The Blood|Seanchan High Ladies]] and prostrated herself before them. She told Elayne and Nynaeve a lot about Seanchan.

Elayne made Cerandin wear the ''a'dam'' to prove she wasn't a ''[[sul'dam]]''. When Elayne and her companions departed Luca's show, Elayne attempted to coerce Cerandin into leaving with them, but Cerandin refused to leave the ''s'redit'' behind.{{ref/book|5|47}}

Later, Mat learned that [[Valan Luca]] was rewarded by the Seanchan for giving shelter to an animal trainer, so Cerandin most likely rejoined her people after the Seanchan conquered [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|9|15}}
